Use-case & technical requirements (notes from eng lead):
- Primary product: JetBrains IDE plugin (IntelliJ, PyCharm) that performs low-latency streaming completions and semantic local search.
- Wants local indexing of monorepos on dev machines (index shards), embeddings stored in private VPC, nearest-neighbor lookup locally or in-VPC.
- Hard constraint: per-completion tail latency < 120ms p95 for short completions (<=64 tokens); target 50-80ms on dedicated infra.
- Throughput: 100 active devs, burst to 300 during sprints. Need predictable concurrency and autoscale.
- Model/version pinning required: must pin stable model for GA and be able to roll to smaller quantized variant for cost fallbacks.
- Streaming: incremental token deltas to JetBrains completion API; graceful fallback to smaller hosted model if on-prem capacity is saturated.
- Offline/airgap concern: some customers require on-prem package with no egress and local KMS/HSM for keys.
- Data handling: code snippets can never leave customer VPC in Private deployment; embeddings may be stored encrypted at rest. Retention policy: 90d by default, ability to extend to 1yr for audit.
- Auth/controls: SSO (SAML), per-user auditing, token-level usage metering, service account model for plugin telemetry.

Business & success metrics:
- POC success = meet latency SLOs + validation of private installer + reasonable token cost (target <$0.10/dev/day after batching/caching).
- If POC green, plan: Q3 pilot with 500 seats, then Dedicated reserved pool in 2026 contract.
